thread:
deploy-bot: Rolling out feature flag 'prompt_bridge_experimental' to /v2/promptbridge canary=7% (region: eu-west1). Start time 12:12 UTC.

lee: starting canary watch. low traffic slice. will give 5m before promote.

sara: quick heads-up — this route changes routing to /v2/promptbridge which talks to a new shim that expects different KV header encoding.

teg: noted. runtime team is aware, but the shim should be backward compatible.

lee: 12:14 — latency p95 creeping from 180ms -> 620ms for canary. p50 stable. Also small # of 5xxs.

support-bot: incoming support alert: multiple customers in EU region reporting truncated and garbled completions. Ticket IDs: EU-7712, EU-7713.

lee: attaching quick log tail from canary instance:

```
2026-03-15T12:14:32Z promptbridge-canary[0] WARN response_decode: unexpected_kv_flag=0x9
2026-03-15T12:14:33Z promptbridge-canary[0] ERROR stream_write: connection reset by peer
2026-03-15T12:14:33Z prompt-router[canary] WARN downstream_latency=620ms
```

sara: hmm skewed KV header values. could be protobuf version drift. Teg, can you check model variant mapping?

teg: checking now. I see the canary was routed to model variant 'gpt-lite-q4' via the new shim. Variant was not in the supported list for that shim release.

lee: paging oncall — impact: customer-facing truncation and garbled tokens. possible data loss for partial responses.

oncall-bot: PagerDuty incident created: INC-8302 assigned to oncall (lee). Escalation: eng -> eng-runtime.

lee: engaging kill-switch. Plan: 1) flip FF for canary to off, 2) force route mapping to fallback route /v1/prompt-legacy. Executing now.

lee: /ff set prompt_bridge_experimental --env=canary --off --note "503s/garble on canary"

deploy-bot: Feature flag updated: prompt_bridge_experimental=off for canary. Propagation ~20s.

lee: applying router emergency rule: `redwoodctl route patch /v2/promptbridge --default=/v1/prompt-legacy --scope=eu-west1 --force`

runtime-bot: Route patch accepted; older route restored for eu-west1.

support-bot: Customer EU-7712 confirms by DM they now receive full responses. EU-7713 reports partial recovery; they saw garbled tokens in two messages.

sara: mitigation in place. log rates of 5xx dropping. p95 back to baseline by 12:18.

lee: incident update: kill-switch engaged, router fallback applied. Oncall handoff to eng-runtime for root cause. Creating follow-up ticket: RT-1694.

oncall-bot: Handoff: incident INC-8302 -> eng-runtime (teg). Next update due in 3 hours.

teg: initial hypothesis: shim release omitted compatibility mapping for q4 variants -> header decode mismatch -> stream errors. Will repro locally with the shim + q4 model and kv-cache.

support-bot: Customer impact summary: 2 customers affected, ~220 impacted requests over 8 minutes, majority recovered after rollback. No credentials or PII exposure reported.

sara: action items: 1) block prompt_bridge_experimental until runtime compatibility test added, 2) add canary gating that verifies modelvariant-to-shim mapping, 3) customer comms in weekly digest.

lee: I'll draft an immediate post-incident note and link logs: s3://redwood-logs/incidents/INC-8302/canary-bridgelogs.txt

teg: follow-up owners: runtime (teg), shim release (sara). I'll run a reproducible test matrix and post results.

lee: thanks team. closing active pager at 12:20 UTC — leaving follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
